visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Shorthand for flex
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The columns set grow, shrink and basis in three separate properties. Use the flex shorthand. They must share the row the same way.

solution.explanation: flex: 1 means flex-grow 1, flex-shrink 1 and flex-basis 0. The short form is what most developers write and read.

checks.label: Both columns have the same width
checks.expr: (() => { var c = document.querySelectorAll('.col'); return c[0].offsetWidth === c[1].offsetWidth; })()

checks.label: The columns fill the row
checks.expr: (() => { var c = document.querySelectorAll('.col'); return Math.abs(c[0].offsetWidth * 2 - el('.row').offsetWidth) <= 1; })()
